metadata.consistency_ledger:
# BINDING CONSISTENCY LEDGER — Swedish (15-Scene Listening Pod)

## TRANSLITERATION
Not needed — names stay as written. Swedish uses Latin script with å, ä, ö.

## PRICES
- £8.40 → åttioåtta kronor
- £12.50 → etthundraåttio kronor

## TARGET-LANGUAGE NAME
Svenska (when the script mentions "Swedish")

## RECURRING LINES

| Canonical | Swedish |
|-----------|---------|
| Good morning. What can I get you? | Godmorgon. Vad kan jag få dig? |
| What can I get you? | Vad kan jag få dig? |
| Good afternoon. What can I get you? | Godeftermiddag. Vad kan jag få dig? |
| Could I pay by card? | Kan jag betala med kort? |
| Do you have contactless? | Har ni kontaktlöst? |
| Thank you very much. Goodbye. | Tack så mycket. Hej då. |
| Excuse me. | Ursäkta. |
| You're welcome. | Varsågod. |
| Pleased to meet you. | Roligt att träffas. |
| I'm learning Swedish. | Jag håller på att lära mig svenska. |
| Are you eating tonight? | Ska ni äta något ikväll? |
| Do you have a menu? | Har ni en meny? |
| Could we split it? | Kan vi dela notan? |
| Thank you, you've been very helpful. | Tack, du har varit till stor hjälp. |
| You speak very good Swedish. | Du talar mycket bra svenska. |
| Welcome. | Välkommen. |
| Here are the menus. | Här är menyerna. |
| Have a lovely stay. | Ha en skön vistelse. |
| I'm not feeling great — could you recommend something? | Jag mår inte så bra — kan du rekommendera något? |
| Thank you. Could I also get... | Tack. Kan jag också få... |

## REGISTER
**Unmarked polite register throughout:** *du* to everyone (barista, waiter, pharmacist, stranger, receptionist, taxi driver, friend, neighbour). No *ni*. Politeness conveyed through *tack*, *varsågod*, tone, and phrasing — not address-form switching. Service staff greet with *Hej!* and close with *Hej då!*
